metas.name: 1. The Star of the Backstage
metas.description: A musical comes to life in Springfield as Marge stages a revival of her beloved high school show - but her wonderful memories are threatened by the return of a rival from the past.

metas.name: 2. Bart's in Jail
metas.description: When Grampa falls victim to a phone scammer, the Simpsons set out on a mission of vengeance to get his money back.

metas.name: 3. Treehouse of Horror XXXII
metas.description: The 32nd annual Simpsons Halloween special includes a spoof of "Parasite" and a segment where Bambi gets his revenge.

metas.name: 4. The Wayz We Were
metas.description: Evergreen Terrace is overrun with traffic and Moe has a fateful choice to make.

metas.name: 5. Lisa's Belly
metas.description: Marge puts a hurtful word in Lisa's brain and Bart gets swole.

metas.name: 6. A Serious Flanders (1)
metas.description: When a ruthless debt collector come to Springfield, Homer and Ned's lives are sucked into the artificial world of prestige TV.

metas.name: 7. A Serious Flanders (2)
metas.description: Things for Ned and Homer go from bad to gosh-darn worse in the stunning conclusion of this 'Simpflix' prestige crime thriller.

metas.name: 8. Portrait of a Lackey on Fire
metas.description: Smithers finds true love with a famous fashion designer, but will his new relationship destroy Springfield?

metas.name: 9. Mothers and Other Strangers
metas.description: In a flashback, Homer goes on a road trip with his father to find his mother.

metas.name: 10. A Made Maggie
metas.description: Fat Tony becomes Godfather to Maggie Simpson.

metas.name: 11. The Longest Marge
metas.description: Marge and Mr. Burns fight for the soul of a brash young football prodigy.

metas.name: 12. Pixelated and Afraid
metas.description: When Homer and Marge are lost in an icy wilderness, they must push themselves to their limits to survive.

metas.name: 13. Boyz N the Highlands
metas.description: Bart, Martin and the bullies run for their lives when a weekend in the wilderness takes a dark turn.

metas.name: 14. You Won't Believe What This Episode Is About -- Act Three Will Shock You!
metas.description: Homer becomes a pariah when footage of him allegedly leaving Santa's Little Helper in a hot car goes viral.

metas.name: 15. Bart the Cool Kid
metas.description: When Bart befriends a famous kid influencer who owns an ultra-cool skate wear brand, Homer leads a rebellion of loser dads against them.

metas.name: 16. Pretty Whittle Liar
metas.description: Cletus discovers that his wife Brandine has been hiding a secret love ... of learning.

metas.name: 17. The Sound of Bleeding Gums
metas.description: Lisa meets the son of the late musician Bleeding Gums Murphy - and attempts to improve his life.

metas.name: 18. My Octopus and a Teacher
metas.description: Bart can't control his feelings when he gets a new teacher. Meanwhile, Lisa befriends an octopus.

metas.name: 19. Girls Just Shauna Have Fun
metas.description: When Lisa joins the high school marching band, she finds an unlikely mentor in Shauna Chalmers. Meanwhile, Homer becomes a craft beer brewer.

metas.name: 20. Marge the Meanie
metas.description: A surprise from Marge's past has her bonding with Bart and terrifying Homer.

metas.name: 21. Meat Is Murder
metas.description: Grampa finds himself in a pickle when his hidden hamburger past comes back to "ketchup" with him.

metas.name: 22. Poorhouse Rock
metas.description: After Bart humiliates him at church, Homer finally teaches his son to admire his dad - until a visit from a magical, singing janitor changes everything they thought they knew.
